name: Asahi Rubber Inc.
summary: Asahi Rubber Inc., based in Saitama, Japan, makes and distributes industrial rubber products. Its range includes ASA COLOR LEDs for automotive interiors such as speedometers, navigation systems and switches, silicone lenses for UV LEDs, color filter sheets, and white silicone ink for UV uses. It also produces medical rubber products such as rubber plugs for infusion bags and vacuum blood collection tubes.
